title: Add comprehensive result page with editing, download, and comparison features

requirements.summary: Create a new comprehensive result page route that displays all parsed resume data including contact information, work experience with durations and descriptions, education history, skills categorized by type (technical, soft, domain) with proficiency levels, and certifications
acceptanceCriteria: Route is accessible after resume analysis completes
All extracted resume fields are displayed in organized sections
Contact information section shows name, email, phone, and location
Work experience section displays each position with company, title, duration, and description
Education section shows degrees, institutions, and graduation dates
Skills are grouped by category with proficiency badges
Certifications are listed with issuing organization and dates

file_operations.description: Create new comprehensive result page component that displays all parsed resume data in organized sections: contact information (name, email, phone, location), work experience (company, title, duration, description for each position), education history (degrees, institutions, graduation dates), skills categorized by type (technical, soft, domain) with proficiency level badges, and certifications (with issuing organization and dates). Use authorization component to require authentication. Fetch resume data using the getResume backend method with documentId from URL params. Display loading states and error handling. Style using the warm education-focused color palette (coral primary, teal secondary, amber accent) from frontend/src/index.css. Ensure responsive layout with proper spacing and visual hierarchy.

Add new route for ComprehensiveResultPage at path '/result/:documentId' in the router configuration. Import the ComprehensiveResultPage component and register it with TanStack Router. Ensure the route is wrapped with authentication checks similar to existing protected routes.
Add navigation link to 'My Results' in the authenticated user menu that routes to the comprehensive result page. Place it after the Dashboard link. Ensure it's only visible to authenticated users.

requirements.summary: Display the comprehensive scoring breakdown on the result page showing the overall resume score, completeness score (name, contact, experience, education, skills), content quality score (experience duration, career progression), formatting score, and skill relevance score with detailed feedback for each dimension
acceptanceCriteria: Overall score is prominently displayed with a progress indicator or chart
Each scoring dimension (completeness, content quality, formatting, skill relevance) shows its individual score
Visual indicators (progress bars, color coding) distinguish score levels
Detailed feedback text explains strengths and areas for improvement in each dimension

file_operations.description: Create ScoreBreakdown component that displays comprehensive scoring breakdown. Show overall resume score prominently with a circular progress indicator or radial chart. Display each scoring dimension (completeness, content quality, formatting, skill relevance) with individual scores using progress bars. Use color coding: green for scores 80+, yellow/amber for 50-79, red for below 50. Include detailed feedback text for each dimension explaining strengths and areas for improvement. Accept ResumeScore object as prop. Use existing resumeScoring.ts service types without modification. Style with warm color palette matching the application theme.

Import and integrate ScoreBreakdown component into the comprehensive result page. Calculate scoring using existing resumeScoring.ts service with the resume data. Position the ScoreBreakdown component prominently near the top of the page after the header section. Pass the calculated ResumeScore object to the component. Ensure the scoring section is visually distinct and easy to locate.

requirements.summary: Show skill matches and gaps on the result page by comparing resume skills against the selected job role requirements, highlighting matching skills with green styling and missing or insufficient proficiency skills with red/yellow styling, categorized by technical and soft skills
acceptanceCriteria: Matching skills are displayed with green indicators
Missing skills are highlighted in red
Skills with insufficient proficiency are shown in yellow/orange
Skills are grouped into technical and soft skill categories
Each skill shows the required vs. current proficiency level

file_operations.description: Create SkillMatchGapDisplay component that shows skill matches and gaps by comparing resume skills against job role requirements. Display matching skills with green styling/badges, missing skills in red, and skills with insufficient proficiency in yellow/amber. Group skills into technical and soft skill categories. For each skill, show the required proficiency level vs. current proficiency level. Use existing gapAnalysis.ts service for skill comparison logic without modification. Accept resume skills and job role as props. Style using the warm color palette with clear visual hierarchy.

Import and integrate SkillMatchGapDisplay component into the comprehensive result page. Fetch the selected job role from URL params or sessionStorage. Use existing gapAnalysis.ts service to perform skill gap analysis between resume skills and job role requirements. Position the SkillMatchGapDisplay component below the ScoreBreakdown section. Pass resume skills and job role data to the component. Handle cases where no job role is selected with appropriate messaging.

requirements.summary: Display actionable recommendations on the result page including personalized learning resources (courses from Udemy, Coursera, freeCodeCamp) and practice projects for each skill gap identified in the analysis
acceptanceCriteria: Recommendations section is clearly visible on the result page
Each missing skill has associated course recommendations with external links
Practice projects are suggested for hands-on skill development
Recommendations are personalized based on the specific skill gaps identified

file_operations.description: Import and integrate the existing RecommendationsDisplay component into the comprehensive result page. Use existing recommendationEngine.ts service to generate personalized recommendations for each skill gap identified in the analysis. Position the RecommendationsDisplay component below the SkillMatchGapDisplay section. Pass the missing skills array to the recommendation engine and display the results. Ensure the recommendations section is clearly visible with appropriate headings and visual hierarchy.

requirements.summary: Implement inline editing functionality on the result page allowing users to modify extracted resume data fields (contact info, work experience, education, skills) with save functionality that updates the backend resume record
acceptanceCriteria: Each editable field has an edit button or inline edit capability
Users can modify text fields, dates, and skill proficiency levels
Changes are validated before saving
Save button persists changes to the backend
Success/error feedback is shown after save attempts
The page reflects updated data immediately after successful save

file_operations.description: Create EditableResumeSection component that provides inline editing functionality for resume data fields. Implement edit mode toggle for each section (contact info, work experience, education, skills). Allow users to modify text fields, dates, and skill proficiency levels with appropriate input types. Include validation before saving (required fields, format checks). Provide save and cancel buttons. Show loading state during save operation. Display success toast on successful save, error toast on failure. Use authorization component to verify user owns the resume before allowing edits. Style with consistent UI matching the application theme.

Wrap resume data display sections (contact info, work experience, education, skills) with EditableResumeSection components. Verify the current user owns the resume using authorization checks (compare identity principal with resume.user). Show edit functionality only for the resume owner. After successful save, use updateResumeData backend method to persist changes. Invalidate relevant React Query cache entries to refresh the display with updated data immediately.

Add useUpdateResumeData mutation hook that calls the updateResumeData backend method. Accept ResumeData object as parameter. Return mutation with onSuccess callback to invalidate resume queries and trigger refetch. Include error handling with toast notifications. Follow existing mutation patterns in the file.

requirements.summary: Add a download report button on the result page that generates and downloads a comprehensive PDF report containing the resume analysis including job role match percentage, matching and missing skills, personalized recommendations, and candidate profile data (experience, education, certifications)
acceptanceCriteria: Download button is prominently displayed on the result page
Clicking the button generates a PDF report
PDF includes all key analysis data: scores, skills, gaps, recommendations
PDF is formatted professionally with clear sections
Download initiates automatically after generation
Loading indicator shows during PDF generation

file_operations.description: Create DownloadComprehensiveReportButton component that generates and downloads a comprehensive PDF report. Use existing pdfGenerator.ts service without modification. Gather all required data: resume analysis scores, job role match percentage, matching skills, missing skills, personalized recommendations from recommendationEngine.ts, candidate profile data (experience, education, certifications). Show loading indicator during PDF generation. Trigger automatic download when PDF is ready. Display error toast if generation fails. Style button prominently using primary coral color from the theme. Position button in a visible action area of the page.

Import and integrate DownloadComprehensiveReportButton component into the comprehensive result page. Position the download button prominently in the top action bar or near the header section. Pass all necessary data to the button component: resume data, scores, job role, skill gaps, and recommendations. Ensure button is accessible after all data has loaded.

requirements.summary: Implement a compare feature on the result page that allows users to select and analyze multiple resumes side-by-side, displaying comparative metrics such as overall scores, skill overlap, experience levels, and education backgrounds for all selected candidates
acceptanceCriteria: Compare button or interface element is available on the result page
Users can select multiple resumes (at least 2) for comparison
Comparison view displays resumes in a side-by-side or tabular layout
Comparative metrics include scores, skills, experience years, and education
Visual indicators highlight differences and strengths across candidates
Users can easily switch between individual and comparison views

file_operations.description: Create CompareResumesView component that displays multiple resumes side-by-side for comparison. Accept array of resume IDs as props. Use compareResumes backend method to fetch comparison data and metrics. Display resumes in a responsive side-by-side or tabular layout. Show comparative metrics: overall scores, skill overlap count, experience levels (years), education count, and certifications count. Use visual indicators (color coding, icons) to highlight differences and strengths across candidates. Include column headers with candidate names. Style with consistent spacing and the application color palette. Handle loading and error states appropriately.

Add compare mode functionality to the comprehensive result page. Include a 'Compare' button in the action bar that opens a resume selection modal. Create a modal component that lists available resumes for the current user using getCallerResumes backend method. Allow multi-select (minimum 2 resumes) with checkboxes. When user confirms selection, toggle to comparison view by rendering CompareResumesView component instead of single resume view. Provide a button to switch back to individual view. Store comparison state locally in component state. Ensure comparison view is responsive and works on mobile/tablet/desktop.

Add useCompareResumes query hook that calls compareResumes backend method with array of Principal IDs. Return ComparisonResult with metrics and resume data. Include loading and error states. Follow existing query patterns in the file.

requirements.summary: Configure automatic navigation to the result page after a user successfully uploads and analyzes a resume, passing the resume ID and analysis data through URL parameters or application state
acceptanceCriteria: After successful resume analysis, user is automatically redirected to the result page
Resume ID is passed to the result page for data retrieval
No manual navigation is required from the user
Transition is smooth with appropriate loading states
If analysis fails, user remains on the upload page with error feedback

file_operations.description: Modify the analysis flow to automatically navigate to ComprehensiveResultPage after successful resume upload and analysis. After the useResumeAnalysis mutation succeeds, use TanStack Router's navigate function to redirect to '/result/:documentId' with the uploaded resume's fileId. Pass the documentId as a URL parameter. Ensure smooth transition with loading states. If analysis fails, keep user on the current page and display error feedback using toast notifications. Do not modify existing analysis logic from useResumeAnalysis hook.

Update ResumeUploadPage to automatically navigate to ComprehensiveResultPage after successful resume upload. Import and use TanStack Router's navigate function. After upload completes successfully, redirect to '/result/:documentId' passing the fileId from the uploaded resume. Include appropriate loading states during upload and navigation. If upload fails, display error message and keep user on upload page.

requirements.summary: Design the result page UI to match the existing application style with warm education-focused color palette (coral primary, teal secondary, amber accent), ensuring responsive layout, proper spacing, and visual hierarchy that highlights key information like scores and recommendations
acceptanceCriteria: Result page uses the same color scheme as other pages (coral, teal, amber)
Layout is responsive and works on mobile, tablet, and desktop
Visual hierarchy emphasizes important elements (scores, gaps, recommendations)
Spacing and typography are consistent with the rest of the application
Interactive elements have appropriate hover and focus states
Loading states are smooth and informative

file_operations.description: Apply comprehensive styling to ComprehensiveResultPage using the warm education-focused color palette from frontend/src/index.css (coral primary, teal secondary, amber accent). Ensure responsive layout using Tailwind breakpoints (mobile, tablet, desktop). Create clear visual hierarchy with larger headings for sections, prominent display of scores and key metrics. Use consistent spacing (padding, margins) matching other pages like AnalysisDashboard and HomePage. Add hover and focus states to interactive elements (buttons, editable fields). Implement smooth loading skeletons or spinners for async data. Use card components for grouped content sections. Ensure text contrast meets accessibility standards. Reference frontend/tailwind.config.js for color values and design tokens.
